description: Everything a crawler or SEO agent needs before visiting a site: robots.txt rules for your user agent (is this URL allowed? crawl delay?), the site's sitemaps with page URLs and last-modified dates (following one sitemap-index level), and the internal/external links on the page. Costs $0.002 per call.

max_urls.description: Sitemap URLs and links to list (default 100 each).

url.description: Page or site URL, e.g. https://example.com/blog

user_agent.description: Crawler name to check rules for (default "*"), e.g. "GPTBot", "Googlebot".

name: site_crawl
title: Crawl rules, sitemap and links
